summary: Worker fell from a raised platform after stepping off the edge, with the hard hat recording a 12.4 g impact during the 450 ms free fall. The fall was fully visible in video and confirmed by sensor data.

sequence_of_events.description: Scene is an indoor construction area with a raised platform and lower level.
Worker standing on platform, holding a long object, preparing to move.
Worker begins stepping down from platform toward lower level.
Worker mid-step, descending platform edge with one leg extended.
Worker’s body leans forward while descending platform edge.
Worker fully in process of falling, both legs dangling over edge.
Worker falling downward, arms extended as if bracing or stabilizing.
Worker in mid-fall, body oriented downward, arms still extended.
Worker continues falling, mostly out of frame’s upper view.
Fall detected: 450 ms free fall (estimated drop 0.99 m) ending in 12.4 g impact.
Confirmation buzz on both motors (1.5 s) to notify wearer event was recorded.

clip_refs.observation: Worker fully in process of falling, both legs dangling over edge.
Worker in mid-fall, body oriented downward, arms still extended.
Worker continues falling, mostly out of frame’s upper view.

evidence.environment: Near-wearer conditions (indicative): CO2 612 ppm, temperature 21.4 C, relative humidity 38%.

hazard.energy_source: gravitational potential energy from height of 0.99 m

risk.severity_justification: The fall resulted in a 12.4 g impact, which could cause injury to the head or spine, but the drop height was low (0.99 m).
risk.likelihood_justification: The worker was on a raised platform and stepped off without apparent warning or fall protection, indicating a foreseeable hazard.

immediate.description: Worker stepped off the platform edge without using fall protection or securing their position.
No fall protection systems (e.g., guardrails, harnesses) were visible or in use at the platform edge.

root_five_whys: Why did the worker step off the platform? Because they were not using fall protection.
Why was fall protection not used? Because it was not provided or required at the platform edge.
Why was it not provided? Because the site’s fall protection policy was not enforced or communicated.
Why was the policy not enforced? Because there was no visible signage or supervisor oversight.
Why was there no supervisor oversight? Because the supervisor was not monitoring the area in real-time.

corrective_actions.description: Install guardrails or temporary fall protection systems at all platform edges.
Require all workers to use fall protection when working at heights, even low ones.
Provide training on fall hazards and PPE use for all crew members.
Implement real-time monitoring of high-risk areas with supervisors or automated alerts.
